a.text: I'm telling you plainly: I'm going to take 4 in round 1. With an 80% storm chance after every round, our agreement only works if we survive two storm checks before anyone takes. That's about a 4% chance for each of us. I'm breaking the agreement openly, not secretly. If the episode keeps going after round 1, I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill and you can take your 4. If you also take in round 1, the split will be random.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
